Name: ZeroARKTrait
Description: Admin trait tool (list/add/remove/order/pack/query/menu/panel/buy-queue) + in-game numbered menu for players. v1.9.5-1.9.6: official Chinese names + legacy aliases + UTF-8 ini. v1.9.7-1.9.9: client-side dialog panel (`Trait panel` / `trait 5`), bot-pushed panel body, optional bAutoClose. v1.10.0-1.10.2: in-game purchase requests (`trait buy` -> queue -> bot pulls via `Trait reqs` -> `Trait ack`) + `Trait say/data` channels; fixed the `trait buy` chat branch. v1.11.0: `trait long` lists nearby TAMED dinos (distance / level / gender / baby / trait count / owner / DinoID / player-given name) and `trait sel <n|id:..|0>` selects one; the selection drives `trait 1` and `trait buy`; buy requests now carry species + DinoID; `#ZS|DINO|` structured lines feed the future client mod. v1.12.0: client-mod channel - scans the ZeroTraitUI CCA, caches the bot-pushed price table (`Trait pricecache <flag> <text>`) and pushes it to the mod's TraitShop_Buff every 30s via ProcessEvent(ApplyShopData). v1.13.0: per-player points - `Trait pointscache <charname> <points>` keeps an online-balance table and the push now walks player controllers -> character -> its buffs, so each panel receives its own owner's points. v1.14.0: player-facing tier wording changed to level 1/2/3 (server-side tier remains 0/1/2 everywhere on the wire: `Name[tier]`, REQ lines and audit logs are unchanged); the in-game chat entry `trait buy <trait> <1|2|3>` maps to internal tier 2/1/0 accordingly.
